adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it does `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and immediately `return response;` without checking `response.ok` / status or parsing/throwing on non-2xx. This allows error responses (4xx/5xx) from the sync endpoint to flow downstream as if successful, leaving error handling to callers that may not expect it (and some callers assume a successful token payload).
